{{ElectionsOH}}
The '''1994 Ohio gubernatorial election''' took place on November 8, 1994. Incumbent [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] [[Governor of Ohio]] [[George Voinovich]] ran for a second term. Voinovich won his party's nomination uncontested and was opposed by [[Ohio State Senate|State Senator]] [[Rob Burch (politician)|Rob Burch]], who won a competitive [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] primary. Ultimately, Voinovich capitalized on his massive popularity within [[Ohio]] and won re-election in an overwhelming landslide, defeating Burch and winning almost 72% of the vote. {{As of|2024}}, this was the last time [[Athens County, Ohio|Athens County]] voted for the Republican candidate.
